description.p: Bucharest Lite is an open-source non-linear video editor (NLE) built with Qt6/C++17 and FFmpeg, featuring a multi-track timeline and GPU-accelerated compositing.

Features include timeline editing (trim, split, ripple, 3-point editing), frame-accurate playback, speed/time remapping, keyframeable clip properties, transitions, video effects (color correction, chroma key), layer-based compositing, titles and subtitles, multi-track audio mixing, scopes, modular FFmpeg-backed codec plugins (h264, vp9, av1, theora, mpeg4, aac, flac, vorbis, opus), proxy editing, project auto-save, unlimited undo/redo, and a custom export pipeline.
